name: Embrace of Death
description: You touch an adjacent creature and restore 10 of their health while setting their resolve to 0. For the next minute, they are immune to all mental conditions, stress, pain and they do not need to breathe. If the target of this spell is unconscious or asleep, they wake up. When the spell ends, the target must make a resilience check of 8. On a success, their resolve becomes 1. On a failure, they gain the broken condition. A creature can only be affected by this spell once per day.
charge: The creature is restored to full health and any bleeding or poisoned conditions are removed.
